method: centered affine variation-of-constants tube with outward rational intervals
outward_rounding: every interval endpoint rounds outward to a multiple of 2^-96
partial_center_slab_policy: Taylor enclosure over every tau in [0,1/128]; each endpoint enclosure is chained to the next slab
parameter_policy: one complete positive-width label image; no subdivision, reset, or favorable relabeling
held_input_policy: one common voltage pair is fixed for the full 2 s hold
unknown_policy: any failed proof obligation, unsupported input, arithmetic cap, wall/memory/output limit, or replay mismatch is UNKNOWN or failure; no retry
